description: This file defines the SessionHandler class implementing PHP's SessionHandlerInterface for storing sessions in Amazon DynamoDB. It includes methods for session lifecycle management such as open, close, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection, along with configuration and connection setup logic.

classes.name: SessionHandler
classes.description: A class providing a session handler implementation that stores session data in Amazon DynamoDB.

methods.name: fromClient
methods.description: Static method to create a SessionHandler instance configured with a DynamoDbClient and optional locking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session handler with a session connection interface.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers this session handler with PHP's native session handling mechanism.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a session, initializing save path and session name.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session, ensuring it is unlocked and expiration time is updated.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from DynamoDB, and deletes expired sessions.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: A no-op garbage collection method; actual cleanup is manual or scheduled.

methods.name: formatId
methods.description: Prepares session ID by prefixing with session name.
